orders.note: binary ordinary curve: the only 2-isogenies are the Frobenius F (inseparable) and the Verschiebung V, so the 2-loops are {2: +n} = pi (acts as 1) and {2: -n} = pi-bar = V^n (acts as q = t - 1 on E(F_q)); both lie in Z[pi]. A GLV split with lambda = t - 1 is the paper's folklore split: it trades the n/2 doublings of [t-1]P for n Verschiebung steps, and the gain is model-dependent (x-only V step ~1M+2S, but y must be recovered).
